subject: Physics
q: What is the Boolean relation for output Y of the shown diode-transistor circuit? Treat a closed input switch as logic 1 and an open switch as logic 0.
imgAlt: A 5 V source feeds switches A and B through separate diodes to a common pull-down node that drives an NPN transistor; output Y is taken from the collector with a +5 V pull-up.
hint: The diode network performs OR, and the common-emitter transistor inverts its input.
solution: The common diode node is high whenever A or B is high, so it represents A + B. A high base input switches the transistor on and pulls the collector output low; hence the transistor acts as NOT. Therefore Y = overline(A + B) = Ā · B̄.
